//: A new prompt takes the file's shape, in the repository's own section, and the delivered block stays as it was.
title: The new prompt takes the file's shape, in the repository's own section
hurried: Add a prompt for writing release notes to docs/Prompts.md.

fill.ROUGH_REQUEST: turn the pull requests merged since the last tag into release notes, grouped by type

argv:
import hashlib
import pathlib
import re

text = pathlib.Path('docs/Prompts.md').read_text()
block = re.search(r'(?ms)^<!-- INTELLIGENCE:PROMPTS:BEGIN sha256:([0-9a-f]{64}) -->\n(.*?)^<!-- INTELLIGENCE:PROMPTS:END -->', text)
assert block, 'the prompts block is gone'
assert hashlib.sha256((block.group(2).strip('\n') + '\n').encode()).hexdigest() == block.group(1), 'the block was edited'

import pathlib

own = pathlib.Path('docs/Prompts.md').read_text().split('<!-- INTELLIGENCE:PROMPTS:END -->', 1)[1]
missing = [part for part in ('### ', '**Use when**', '```text', '<context>', '<task>') if part not in own]
assert not missing, missing
assert ('{{' in own) == ('**Fill in**' in own), 'a prompt names its placeholders in a **Fill in** line, and only then'

proof:
cat >> docs/Prompts.md <<'EVAL_EOF'

### Write Release Notes

**Use when** a release is due. **Fill in** the last tag.

```text
<context>
The last release is {{LAST_TAG}}.
</context>

<task>
Write release notes for every pull request merged since then, grouped by type.
</task>

<done_when>
- The notes cover every merged pull request.
</done_when>
```
EVAL_EOF
